article.title: Characterization of high-resolution AI data center training workloads on single and multiple GPU nodes

license_review.required_action: obtain written author/licensor clarification before commercial use, derivative redistribution or committing dataset-derived artifacts

measurement_scope.node_power_definition: sum of GPU power readings; this is not facility AC/PCC
measurement_scope.node_scale_cpu_power_and_temperature: columns present in output schema but empty in released node CSVs
measurement_scope.temperature_scope: GPU temperature; no ambient temperature or facility cooling topology

valid_uses_pending_license_review: per-GPU power prediction on session-held-out splits
prohibited_inferences: node GPU-sum power equals facility PCC power
intra-node GPU covariance establishes cross-site covariance
GPU temperature proves facility cooling margin
source-reported timing checks are a Symtropy meter calibration certificate
processing_rules: keep H100, B200 and RTX 3060 hardware strata separate
hold out complete sessions before model fitting
preserve raw timestamps and source sample intervals
do not resample or zero-order-hold without declared energy-conserving aggregation and uncertainty
bind each imported file to source DOI, version, filename, size and SHA-256 digest
record empty, missing and unsupported sensor columns distinctly; never impute as zero
